schedule.title: No more asking who's free when
schedule.text: Add your week and share it with whoever you like. The app finds the gap; tap "Plan" and the meetup is ready.

week.title: Your week on one screen
week.text: Classes, work, gym; enter it once and it repeats. With your partner, see both weeks together in the "Together" view.
bullets: You choose who sees your schedule

people.title: Your people, one tap away
people.text: Message, nudge, check their week or find free time from their profile.

plans.title: Everyone knows their part
plans.text: Meetups, to-dos and tasks in one place. Who's coming, who's doing what, what's done; all at a glance.

poll.title: Put the date to a vote
poll.text: Suggest a few days and places; everyone ticks what works and the favourite rises to the top.

todos.title: Shared to-dos
todos.text: Groceries, chores, the picnic list. Whoever you share with sees it, and you see who ticked what.

tasks.title: Tasks for things with a deadline
tasks.text: Jobs with a priority, a date and progress; your phone reminds you when it's time.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.text: Meetups, deadlines, birthdays. Your phone tells you when it's time.

offline.title: Works offline too
offline.text: Messages and ticks you make offline aren't lost; they're sent when you're back.

projects.title: A proper workspace for the things you build together
projects.text: Assignments, events, apps, moving house. Hand out roles, split the work into weeks, see what's waiting on what.

review.title: Finished work comes to you
review.text: Members "Send for review" when they're done; the lead approves it or sends it back with a note.

timeline.title: Timeline and critical path
timeline.text: The app works out which task would delay everything and lays the work out across the days.
bullets: List, Kanban board and Gantt timeline

roadmap.title: Roadmap and strategy
roadmap.text: Week-by-week plans, priorities, acceptance criteria; brief, SWOT, risks.

pages.title: Page plans and designs
pages.text: For web and mobile: page-by-page plans, designs, notes pinned on the image.

templates.title: Templates
templates.text: Start from 8 ready-made templates or one shared by your friends.

chat.title: The plan is right there while you talk
chat.text: Tag the meetup, plan, task or schedule in chat; no more "which Friday?".

circles.title: A chat for every circle
circles.text: Friends, team, flatmates, partner. Every chat gets its own theme.
bullets: Reactions, replies, edits, delete for everyone

notifications.title: Nothing important slips by
notifications.text: Notifications are colour-coded by type: meetups, your people, your partner, projects. You set the quiet hours.
bullets: Previews encrypted with your device's key

talkAbout.title: Talk about it
talkAbout.text: Attach the meetup, shared plan, project or task to a message. You can even start a group with everyone involved in one tap.

theme.title: A shared chat theme
theme.text: Colour, pattern and font; everyone in the chat sees the same theme.

encrypted.title: Stored encrypted
encrypted.text: Messages are stored encrypted on the server. It isn't end-to-end encryption, and we say so plainly.

couples.title: A little corner that's yours
couples.text: Add someone as your partner and a space just for the two of you opens on top of everything else.

plans.title: "This or that?"
plans.text: Suggest two options for tonight and let them choose. Or just "you decide".

games.title: Play together
games.text: Draw and guess, How well do you know me?, This or that and more. Play at the same time.
bullets: Tic-tac-toe, Connect four, Finish the story

moments.title: A small moment every day
moments.text: A daily photo theme, a daily question, your important dates and a love-language quiz.
bullets: First met, first date and countdowns
Plan ideas for your love languages

memories.title: Memories and a time capsule
memories.text: A photo journal, "a year ago today" and a capsule that opens in the future.

lists.title: Shared lists and tasks
lists.text: Watchlists, places to go, chores; your progress at a glance.

trust.title: You choose who sees what
trust.text: Share your schedule, status and tasks person by person; personal details are always optional.

encrypted.title: Messages stored encrypted
encrypted.text: Message texts are encrypted on the server; notification previews open only with your device's key. It isn't end-to-end encryption.

block.title: Block and report
block.text: Reports are reviewed by a moderation team and accounts can be restricted. Nobody is told who reported them.

download.title: Download your data
download.text: Get a copy of your data from Settings → Account → "Download my data".

delete.title: Delete your account for good
delete.text: Any time from the app, or by email if you can't get in.
